posts.title: A Daytime Eclipse: Moon Occults Venus
posts.lead: There was something behind the clouds. Upon close inspection, it was the Moon, which was hard to see yesterday around noon above the small village of Cessy, France. But soon, it was not only the Moon.

posts.title: Fuel Savings Double Potential Lifetime for NASA’s Roman Mission
posts.lead: The results are in: NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope’s very accurate first mid-course correction, along with other fuel savings, are expected to more than double the mission’s potential operational lifetime.
